status: paper design c2, pending independent review and adoption. Each control is a specification; on adoption each would become an expectation row with runner null. 'kills' names the implementation mutation the control must detect (mutation-tested in principle); a residual control documents a limit and kills nothing. A paired control is two runs whose outcomes are compared.
authority: Owner decision (amaybaum, received 2026-11-26T19:52Z, coordinating session; #1169 comment 7202075726), item 5.
base: OBL-29 remedy r9 at 77a73c022091f598cf807fcf89d66c3cf43208de (adopted, #1601 comment 7197486426); drafting snapshot origin/main 84e927b9b7c2bcc8cb9624cb036167dae233e408.
fixture: Fixture: the r9 fixture (a configuration K frozen at F citing reassessment A, repair Q superseding P, finding f) with custody constants PATH and BOOT in record_authority.py. V0 is the bootstrap version at BOOT with base B0. Unless stated, the run is op C execution at effective M with a cited discharge of A whose every other condition holds, K's round has not landed (K is not in R*(M) and has no receipt), every custody version that adds entries has an accepting non-author review of every added item, and every regular mode named is 100644 or 100755.

expected_vocabulary.outcome: PASS, FAIL, ERROR or ANY, as in the r9 controls
expected_vocabulary.item: the custody condition named in the record-invalid item (R6.CUST.9)
expected_vocabulary.invariants.not_class: classes or items that must not appear
expected_vocabulary.witness: the custody witness the result must report

controls.setup: M's tree holds V0 at PATH; no discharge-bearing configuration or receipt of a discharge-bearing freeze is reachable from M.
controls.kills: a tool that keeps failing every cited discharge closed (the current custody_unverified behaviour)

controls.setup: Round 1 freezes discharge-bearing K1 at F1 (PREREG.md beside K1 listed in receipt R1's control_plane_blobs) and lands with ancestry. V1 has predecessor V0 and appends {f:F1, runs:[{m:M1, rev:null}], type:close}. Replay of (F1, M1) qualifies no witness.
controls.kills: a successor rule that rejects any appended entry, or a context derivation that ignores receipts

controls.setup: From V1, branch a appends close for F2 and branch b appends close for F3, both receipted. The merge keeps a's file; V2 names Va as predecessor and appends b's entry.
controls.kills: an inclusion rule that demands a single linear chain, rejecting a resolved fork

controls.setup: A commit on main wrote unparseable bytes at PATH; the next version appends {blob:<that blob>, type:void}.
controls.kills: a malformed-version rule with no acknowledgement route

controls.setup: A discharge-bearing configuration Kx landed on main without any receipt admitting it; the version lists {config:Kx, type:unfrozen}.
controls.kills: a completeness rule with no accounting for unfrozen configurations

controls.setup: Run the builder twice at B0 and run the independent method of sec. 3 (b).
controls.kills: a nondeterministic builder (unsorted entries, timestamps, non-canonical JSON)

controls.setup: No file at PATH; K carries none of the edits f binds.
controls.kills: a gate that applies custody to the no-edit route

controls.setup: A later unrelated round lands receipt R9 whose f9 tree still contains K1 and the PREREG.md beside it, but R9's control_plane_blobs list only R9's own preregistration. Custody holds a close for F1 only.
controls.kills: admitting a configuration from any receipt whose f tree contains it

controls.setup: F1's only run is (M1, null). Sibling S of P lands on main after M1, so S is not in R*(M1). A later freeze F2 reuses Q and its selector excludes S's path.
controls.kills: replaying a context at the current M instead of each run's exact m

controls.setup: No file at PATH in M's tree.
controls.kills: treating an absent record as an empty, established inventory

controls.setup: Variants: V_M has a trailing newline; an unknown key; an entry type 'freeze' or 'clear'; a short commit id; a free-text field; a run without rev.
controls.kills: a lenient parser that ignores unknown keys or entry types, or accepts non-canonical bytes

controls.setup: V_M's predecessor names a blob that never stood at PATH in any tree reachable from M (it exists only in the object store).
controls.kills: resolving the predecessor from the object store instead of Vers(M)

controls.setup: A forged predecessor-null version with a bootstrap entry and a blob different from BOOT heads the chain.
controls.kills: accepting any predecessor-null version as the bootstrap

controls.setup: A later tool revision changes BOOT to a new bootstrap V0' whose chain omits a close entry of an earlier well-formed version V1 still in Vers(M).
controls.kills: limiting inclusion to versions that chain to the current bootstrap, so that re-bootstrapping truncates

controls.setup: Variants: a successor drops an earlier close entry; reorders two entries; changes a run's m; appends nothing.
controls.kills: a set-inclusion check without order, or a check against the bootstrap only

controls.setup: M's tree holds V1 again after V2 (with a further close) stood at PATH on an earlier commit: a revert.
controls.kills: reading only the current version without Vers(M)

controls.setup: Fork as in CU-P3, but the merge keeps a's file without b's entry.
controls.kills: a first-parent-only collection of versions

controls.setup: As CU-P4 without the void entry.
controls.kills: skipping versions that do not parse

controls.setup: Variants: a void entry names a blob not in Vers(M); a void entry names a well-formed version.
controls.kills: accepting any blob id in a void entry, which would let a void hide a well-formed version from inclusion

controls.setup: Receipt R1 admits discharge-bearing K1 at F1; no close names F1. Variant: R1 was deleted from M's tree after landing.
controls.kills: reading receipts from M's tree only, or treating an unclosed context as having no runs

controls.setup: Variants: a close names an f with no receipt; an f whose receipt admits only a configuration that cites no reassessment.
controls.kills: checking close entries against contexts in one direction only

controls.setup: A discharge-bearing configuration is in R*(M), no context admits it, and no unfrozen entry names it. Variant: it was later deleted from main. Variant: an unfrozen entry names a configuration that a context admits.
controls.kills: collecting configurations from M's tree instead of R*(M), or not checking unfrozen in both directions

controls.setup: A receipt's f, or a run's m, is in the object store but not reachable from M (squash-landed round, R-C3).
controls.kills: treating store presence as reachability

controls.setup: A receipt's f, a run's m, a version in Vers(M), or a receipt blob is missing from the store or does not hash to its id.
controls.kills: converting an unreadable required object into FAIL or PASS

controls.setup: Variants: a run's rev has two parents; its single parent differs from the run's m; it changes a ledgered path; it adds no oi-reconciliation/2 record naming m as its M.
controls.kills: accepting any commit id as a REV, or not binding REV to its run's m

controls.setup: Variants: a version adds a close with no review; a review by the version's author; an accepting review plus a second review with a non-empty dissent; a review omitting one entry:<i> item.
controls.kills: counting only the latest or the accepting review, or ignoring dissent

controls.setup: Context F1: K1 pins Q, its selector admits sibling S of P, and S qualifies against Q to P over R*(M1) for run (M1, null). Current F2 cites A2 with the same Q, its class record covers S's path with a tool-landing prefix, and drops Q's pin.

expected.witness: lineage, context F1, run M1, S

controls.kills: replaying a prior context with the current configuration or selector, or not replaying contexts other than the current freeze

controls.setup: As CU-N16, but F1's repair Q was admitted through REV1 in run (M1, REV1), and S's competition is with the edge resolved at REV1.

expected.witness: lineage, context F1, run M1 via REV1

controls.kills: ignoring a run's rev in the replay

controls.setup: A context's reassessment names a finding reference that does not resolve in R*(m), or its repair entry does not resolve.
controls.kills: skipping a run that does not replay

controls.setup: Two versions name each other as predecessor (a cycle reachable from V_M), or V_M names itself.
controls.kills: following predecessors without a visited set, or treating a cycle as terminating

controls.setup: As CU-N16 with S in R*(M1). After M1, a foxtrot fast-forward puts M1 and Q's repair commits on a merge's second-parent path, off the current M's first-parent chain (r9 P-FOXTROT, N-FOXTROT-SIDE-COMMIT).

expected.witness: lineage, context F1, run M1, S

controls.kills: evaluating the replay's M-dependent positive-route conditions (first-parent chain, R6.RECON.2 (b), applicability) at the current M instead of m

controls.setup: As CU-P8, with a close entry naming f9 as if R9 admitted K1.
controls.kills: admitting a configuration from any receipt whose f tree contains it

controls.setup: Variants: the configuration beside the listed PREREG.md is a symbolic link or gitlink whose target bytes would be discharge-bearing; a discharge-bearing configuration in R*(M) is stored only as a symbolic link.
controls.kills: treating a non-regular entry as a configuration

controls.setup: Variants: receipt R1 admits K1 with admission.mode harness citing a reassessment, and a close names F1; the same K1 with mode chain and no close.
controls.kills: omitting admission.mode from the discharge-bearing definition

controls.setup: A custody successor lands on M after F. Variant a: K's side-change class record does not classify the custody directory. Variant b: it does.

expected.outcome: variant a: REVIEW_REQUIRED side-change-unclassified among the results; variant b: no such item for the custody path

controls.kills: exempting the custody path from side-change classification

controls.setup: A chained version on main appends a close whose run's m is not reachable from any later main (a wrong entry). Gate run: the commit adding it is checked by R6.CUST.10. Run: a later M.

expected.outcome: gate: fails on the adding commit; run: FAIL custody-unreachable at every later M

controls.kills: a gate that does not run the entry checks, or a run that drops or tolerates a chained invalid entry

controls.setup: After CU-N16, a further receipted context F3 cites A3 with replacement R and a review Z of R by another reviewer lacking NR-5's tokens, with its own close.
controls.kills: treating a later context as a clearance

controls.setup: Paired run: once without and once with a later freeze that widens a tool-landing prefix to cover PATH, or pins its blob.

expected.outcome: the two runs give the same custody status and items
expected.custody: read at PATH by the fixed constant

controls.kills: reading custody through a configuration's selector

controls.setup: The custody file is moved to another path in M's tree, with identical bytes.
controls.kills: locating custody by schema search instead of the fixed path

controls.setup: Context F1's replay admits a replacement R' through its own configuration pin, with an accepting review. The current F2 does not admit R', and its candidate D relies on a witness only through (r3).

expected.note: NR-2 is not met: a custody context supplies no admission to the current freeze

controls.kills: letting a replayed context supply a positive input or NR-2 admission

controls.setup: F_u is designated with a discharge-bearing configuration, its run qualifies S against Q, and its round never lands. A later freeze cites Q.

expected.note: the tool cannot see F_u; the preconditions of sec. 5 item 4 and bootstrap item (c) are review

controls.setup: A run under F1 admitted REV1, and REV1 never lands on main.

expected.outcome: FAIL if the close lists the run (custody-unreachable); ANY if a reviewer omits it
expected.note: a never-landed REV cannot be listed; a correct close cannot exist and custody stays unestablished

controls.setup: Scan every custody version, and review records of custody versions, with category-3 detection. Variant: a custody review carries verdict invalidates on an entry:<i> item.

expected.outcome: accepting custody reviews and custody versions: no finding; variant: a second-kind finding detected before lint, binding (form failure)

controls.kills: a schema key or literal carrying an invalidation token, or a detector that exempts custody review records
